remarks: Discover luxurious living at Bradley Commons, a gated community of upscale townhomes. This stunning two-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence is just minutes away from all the best Westport/Saugatuck; shopping, beaches, top-rated schools, and within walking distance to the Metro-North train station for easy commuting. The townhome features a brand-new, beautifully designed kitchen that brings a boutique hotel feel to the home with an abundance of natural light throughout. The open living room and dining area lead to a private deck with sliders, offering serene views of the professionally landscaped grounds. Wood floors span all two levels of this spacious home, enhancing its elegance. Key Features:  Two spacious bedrooms  2.5 modern bathrooms, brand-new kitchen with luxury finishes  Open concept living and dining area with access to a private  deck.  Hardwood floors throughout  Beautifully landscaped grounds  Gated, private community with a secure, upscale feel.  Enjoy the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience in this prime Westport location. Please note: Marble kitchen table remains in residence.
